findings.title: A left-to-right field typed right to left
findings.message: This tel field inherits right to left.
findings.fix: Add dir="ltr" to the input, or dir="auto" if people may type Arabic too.
findings.snippet: <input id="phone" name="phone" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="050 123 4567" aria-describedby="phone-hint" required="">

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: right: 18px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.

findings.title: Spacing that does not mirror
findings.message: padding-right: 45px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
